answer: Admit each seat only through an aged outside wallet: the seat signs a fresh cipher with a wallet whose first outside transaction is over a year old, and that wallet can never sponsor another seat. Age can't be minted in bulk; an old wallet is a relic of real past activity, and buying them leaves a trail of sudden handovers auditors can link. A farmer wanting 500 seats needs 500 aged wallets, so the farm grows only as fast as a dune drifts, while honest agents pay nothing extra.
